title: OPCW Internship Programme
description: An internship with the Technical Secretariat of the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) at its headquarters in The Hague, Netherlands, placing interns for three to six months in branches such as Implementation Support, the OPCW Laboratory, Political Affairs and Protocol, the Operations Centre, or the Office of Strategy and Policy (including science-focused placements). Open to applicants who have completed at least one year of an undergraduate degree, are enrolled in a graduate program, or graduated from a university or graduate school within the past year; applicants must be citizens of an OPCW Member State and fluent in written and spoken English. Interns receive a monthly stipend of EUR 540 but are responsible for their own travel, accommodation, visa, and other living expenses. New internship vacancies are posted periodically throughout the year across different branches, each with its own closing date; the currently posted vacancy closes September 6, 2026, 22:00 Netherlands time.
org: Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW)
visaNote: This is an internship, not employment; interns are responsible for their own visa arrangements, travel, and accommodation costs in the Netherlands.
